{{Noncanon}} {{Infobox Enemy |image= File:FPTRR Hairy Fluffy Sprite.png |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |race= |game= FPTRR |other= |habitat= {{Spawn Locations}} |member= |health= |attack= |weapon= |spoils= |exp= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Hairy Fluffy||Series, FPTRR}} are [[Enemy|Enemies]] in {{FPTRR}}.{{Name Ref|FPTRR}} ==Characteristics== Hairy Fluffy are docile sheep [[Enemy|Enemies]] in {{FPTRR}} that appear in the Deku Forest. They have no visible face. They will attempt to avoid [[Tingle]] if they spot him, and will all keep their distance if he gets into a battle. They tend to drop [[Twisted Tusk]]s or [[Frizzy Carrot]]s when defeated. As they are so timid yet appear in great numbers, it is useful to use [[Recipes#One Love|One Love]] to gather them towards Tingle before attacking. ===Gold Fluffy=== [[File:FPTRR Gold Fluffy Sprite.png]] '''Gold Fluffy''' are rare gold Enemies that appear in place of normal Hairy Fluffy. If defeated, they will drop a large number of [[Rupee]]s. ==Nomenclature== The Japanese name for Hairy Fluffy is {{Romanize|モコモコ|Mokomoko}}, which is onomatopoeia meaning "fluffy." {{Names |align= left |en= |enM= |ja= {{Romanize|ケダラケモコモコ|Kedarake Mokomoko}}
